question: Mr. Z starts from Point A and drives 18 km towards the North. He then takes a left turn, drives 14 km, then turns left and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn, drives 13 km, then turns left and drives 25 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 34 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 21 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Mr. Z starts from Point A and drives 18 km towards the North.

He then takes a left turn, drives 14 km, then turns left and drives 14 km.

He then takes a right turn, drives 13 km, then turns left and drives 25 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 34 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 21 km, and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d7ab4884d703382d8ea2a4c4456f1327520db4ef9322e7b207000d7c362f25c.png] 

So, He should drive **7 km to the west** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
